name: The Gift of Running 2026
short_description: The Gift of Running 2026 is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Central Park, Filinvest City, Alabang, with 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km and a 1 km dog run.
ai_summary: The Gift of Running 2026, subtitled With Purpose and Hope, is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Central Park in Filinvest City, Alabang, Muntinlupa, with the start listed at 3:30 am. It offers 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and 3 km races and a 1 km dog run, with fees from PHP 850 to PHP 1,850. The organiser is Rule & Rich Events Management Services, which runs the MNLCITY RUN events.

core_facts.organizer: Rule & Rich Events Management Services (MNLCITY RUN)

faqs.question: When is The Gift of Running 2026?
faqs.answer: The race is on Sunday 6 December 2026, with the start listed at 3:30 am Philippine time. It is held in early December at a township venue in southern Metro Manila. Separate gun times for each distance and cut-off times have not yet been posted on the MyRunTime entry page.

faqs.question: What distances and fees are there?
faqs.answer: Five categories are offered: 21 km at PHP 1,850, 10 km at PHP 1,450, 5 km at PHP 1,150, 3 km at PHP 1,050 and a 1 km dog run at PHP 950. Early-bird prices were PHP 100 lower until 24 October 2026, and platform fees are charged on top.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: Start and finish are at Central Park in Filinvest City, Alabang, in Muntinlupa at the southern edge of Metro Manila. The township's wide, tree-lined roads host several road races each year, and the venue is close to the South Luzon Expressway for runners coming from Laguna and Cavite.
